files: Nyaya Sutra Bhashya of Vatsayna Extracts from Nyaya Vartika & Tatparya Tika Rama Sastri Tailangana VSS 11 1896_djvu.txt

normalization: The Internet Archive's own text layer (_djvu.txt) as served, under original/<identifier>/, copied to text/<slug>.ocr.txt with line endings normalized. The scan is held by reference at its Archive URL and not copied. No text was corrected by hand; the loci keep the OCR's readings. The OCR misreads conjuncts often (1.1.1 is read प्रमाणप्रमेयसंशयग्रयोजन for …प्रयोजन); the loci keep its readings.
scope: The five adhyāyas with the Bhāṣya.
why_seated: Inference (anumāna) reasoned about without the Organon: the five-membered argument (pañcāvayava) and the sixteen categories.

research.study: Critique of Pure Inference (working draft v1.1) and The Production of Readers (#1767), §11.6 "the witnesses between"
research.for: the reception history of inference from the Peripatos to the machine: the commentators who name Aristotle's ἑταῖροι, the Latin handbooks, the early-modern refusals of the syllogism, the nineteenth-century rebuilds, and the traditions that reasoned about inference without the Organon
